description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Appoint a Stabilization Committee ( Regulations Under Sports Law No. 25 of 1973)
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Roshan Ranasinghe, Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs) and outlines detailed responsibilities and powers granted to him under the Sports Law, including suspending the Rugby Federation's registration and appointing a Stabilization Committee. It also lists specific individuals appointed to committee positions with their roles (Chairman, Secretary, Treasurer, Members), combining both personnel appointments and detailed administrative responsibilities.
